notes: CDER CGMP letter for an OTC finished-pharmaceutical manufacturer based entirely on a section 704(a)(4) records review (component identity/contamination testing, stability program, process validation, test-method validation, incomplete lab records) -- no on-site inspection occurred, so location_contains is null, comparable to the tianjin-kilo-pharmaceutical precedent. No specific product name is ever stated (all redacted as (b)(4) or referred to generically as 'OTC drug products'); since no name is even referenced as redacted, product_redacted is false rather than true. No sterile/aseptic claims are made.
